adapters.label: Waste Smart standard event (bridge / any HTTP client)
adapters.notes: POST {"events":[{"uid":"…","ts":"ISO8601","value":1.23,"unit":"kg"}]} with the device key. The bridge agent and the simulator use this.

adapters.label: Any JSON webhook (you define the mapping)
adapters.notes: Paste a sample payload in the mapping tester, point fields at it with {{path}} templates.

adapters.label: Any CSV export (upload or scheduled drop)
adapters.notes: Column headers become {{Header Name}} in the mapping. Rows are de-duplicated by event_uid, so re-uploading the same file is safe.

adapters.label: Any POS order webhook (order with line items)
adapters.notes: One sale row per line item. Edit the paths to match your POS payload. Use {{$root.field}} to reach order-level fields.

adapters.label: POS write-offs / voids with reason codes (webhook or CSV)
adapters.notes: One row per voided or wasted item. Map the reason (e.g. Burnt, Dropped, Customer send-back, Spoiled) and the cost or price of the item.

adapters.label: Clock-in / clock-out shifts (POS or time and attendance)
adapters.notes: Send the shift at clock-in, and again at clock-out with the same id. Only role and times are used; no pay rates are stored.

adapters.label: Yoco (payment webhook)
adapters.notes: UNVERIFIED payload shape — Yoco's API reference could not be fetched while building this. Register the webhook URL in the Yoco portal, send a test payment, paste the captured payload into the mapping tester and adjust paths. Amounts from Yoco are normally in cents (hence div:100).

adapters.label: Yoco (poll orders API)
adapters.notes: UNVERIFIED. Needs a Yoco API key with orders:read. Base https://api.yoco.com. Test with a real response before relying on it.

adapters.label: Shelly Pro 3EM / EM Gen2 (via bridge, local network)
adapters.notes: Bridge polls http://<ip>/rpc/EMData.GetStatus?id=0 and reads total_act (Wh, cumulative). See bridge/bridge.example.json.

adapters.label: Modbus energy / water / gas meter (via bridge)
adapters.notes: Bridge reads a holding/input register (TCP or RTU). Set register, type (u16/u32/f32), scale in bridge.json.

adapters.label: Pulse-output meter (water / gas / kWh) via bridge or LoRa node
adapters.notes: Counter mode with multiplier = units per pulse (e.g. 10 L/pulse).

adapters.label: Serial / USB kitchen scale (RS-232, USB-serial) via bridge
adapters.notes: Bridge parses the scale's print line (stable weight) and posts one event per stable weighing.

adapters.label: LPG cylinder load-cell scale (gas by weight)
adapters.notes: Post gross weight periodically. Set tare = empty cylinder weight. Daily gas used = sum of weight drops; refills/swaps (rises) are ignored.

adapters.label: LoRaWAN via ChirpStack (HTTP integration)
adapters.notes: Assumes the node's codec outputs {"object":{"value":…}}. Edit the value path to match your codec.

adapters.label: LoRaWAN via The Things Stack (webhook)
adapters.notes: Assumes decoded_payload.value. Edit to match your payload formatter.

adapters.label: MQTT topic (JSON payload) via bridge
adapters.notes: Bridge subscribes to a topic and forwards each message; use the mapping here to read the JSON.

targets.label: Kitchen waste (all waste thrown away: prep and plate)
